statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH because the latest verified futures tone is firm and live no-retracement NQ structure is not independently verified; fresh Saudi-Houthi escalation keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the next concentrated risk checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC U.S. data cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery.
headline: Fresh Middle East escalation lifts Stress while Tail remains low
body: Latest verified reporting showed Nasdaq futures up 0.6%, the 2-year Treasury yield near 4.71%, the 10-year near 4.99% and the dollar at a seven-week high after the Fed hike. Fresh Saudi-Houthi escalation adds geopolitical risk, while oil had eased. No independently verified live NQ failed-retracement sequence is available at the cutoff.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 hourly publications, Tail rose from low into WATCH/elevated around the FOMC sequence, peaked at 25% at 20:08 UTC, then decayed to 18% by 04:08 UTC as the market returned to two-way behavior.
outlookSummary: Conditional Tail stays low through early Europe, rises into WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. claims, housing and Philly Fed cluster plus cash-open price discovery, then decays if meaningful retracements persist. Fresh geopolitical headlines can lift Stress without mechanically raising Tail.

forecast.analysis: Late-morning U.S. trade should clarify whether the session is directional or rotational. Two-way structure lowers Tail; repeated extension would prevent further decay.
Into midday, conditional Tail sits at the bottom of WATCH. Meaningful retracements and fading cross-asset alignment would return it to low; renewed extreme-holding would delay that normalization.
Midday liquidity can exaggerate moves, but absent fresh one-way evidence the conditional base case returns to low Tail while Stress remains elevated by rates and geopolitics.
